title: 数据库慢查询

segments.spoken: One customer search query now scans two million rows instead of twenty thousand. The release added a filter that changed the access plan.

segments.spoken: Production traces link it to the affected search requests. Other database operations remain near baseline, and overall request volume hasn't changed significantly.

title: 锁等待与长事务

segments.spoken: Scenario 52. Databases, middleware, and batch processing.

segments.text: Several account updates have been waiting for six minutes. Can we terminate the blocking session now and let those requests move forward?

segments.spoken: It belongs to the reconciliation job and has modified about four hundred thousand rows. Termination could trigger a lengthy rollback while locks remain held.

segments.spoken: Its processed row count is increasing, and it isn't waiting on another lock. However, the current transaction is much larger than the job's usual batches.

segments.speaker: A

segments.spoken: I'll check whether the blocked requests can expire safely and confirm that customers won't receive duplicate updates when they try again later.

segments.speaker: C

segments.spoken: I'll collect progress and lock measurements for the next five minutes. If termination is chosen, I'll execute it under approval and monitor rollback explicitly.

segments.spoken: Let's review those measurements with the job owner and incident lead at that checkpoint. Recovery requires completed account updates, not just a disappeared session.

title: 数据库复制延迟

segments.text: Please tell support that saved changes are present in the checked examples. Avoid promising an exact catch-up time until you have a stable processing trend.

segments.speaker: A

title: 数据库主备切换

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: Scenario 54. Databases, middleware, and batch processing.
segments.spoken: Scenario 54. Databases, middleware, and batch processing.

segments.speaker: B

segments.spoken: I need to confirm replication state and fence the old primary. We must prevent it from accepting writes if it becomes reachable again.

segments.speaker: C
segments.text: The infrastructure team confirmed the fence blocks every old-primary write path. Replication checks are complete, and I'm ready to promote once approval is recorded.

segments.speaker: B

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: After promotion, I'll refresh connections gradually and test account reads and order writes. We'll verify persistence, error rates, and business reconciliation before declaring recovery.

title: 备份成功与恢复验证

segments.text: Scenario 55. Databases, middleware, and batch processing.
segments.spoken: Scenario 55. Databases, middleware, and batch processing.

segments.spoken: Our objectives are one hour for service recovery and no more than five minutes of lost data. How will you measure those separately?

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: We'll record when recovery is requested and when the application is usable. Separately, we'll identify the latest recovered transaction and compare its timestamp with the simulated incident.
segments.spoken: We'll record when recovery is requested and when the application is usable. Separately, we'll identify the latest recovered transaction and compare its timestamp with the simulated incident.

segments.spoken: Agreed. We'll use the service's documented measurement boundaries and show each stage. Any pre-provisioned resources will be listed so the result has clear limits.

segments.speaker: C
segments.text: After restoration, I'll check database integrity and the latest committed records. A running database alone won't prove that all required application data is available.

segments.speaker: B
segments.text: I'll arrange an application tester to verify login, order lookup, and a controlled transaction. Please avoid sending notifications or payments from the test environment.
segments.spoken: I'll arrange an application tester to verify login, order lookup, and a controlled transaction. Please avoid sending notifications or payments from the test environment.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: External side effects will be isolated in the test setup. I'll publish the measured recovery time, recovered data point, and functional results after the exercise.

title: Redis缓存命中率下降

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: Scenario 56. Databases, middleware, and batch processing.
segments.spoken: Scenario 56. Databases, middleware, and batch processing.

segments.speaker: B

segments.spoken: Database traffic increased sharply after the Redis restart, and customers report slower page loads. Should we clear the cache again in case entries are inconsistent?

segments.spoken: The hit rate fell from ninety-five percent to fifteen percent because the cache is cold. Another flush could prolong the database load spike.

segments.text: Do we have evidence of incorrect values, or is this mainly missing entries? We shouldn't treat a performance problem as data corruption without checking.

segments.text: Sampled values match the database, and misses account for most additional queries. I'll keep checking correctness while we investigate why warming is slow.
segments.spoken: Sampled values match the database, and misses account for most additional queries. I'll keep checking correctness while we investigate why warming is slow.

segments.speaker: B
segments.text: Our usual warm-up job loads popular product records, but it's currently disabled. Can we start it now and let customer requests fill the rest?

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: We'll start below the approved warm-up rate and pause if database latency crosses our operating threshold. I'll monitor hit rate, evictions, and successful page requests.
segments.spoken: We'll start below the approved warm-up rate and pause if database latency crosses our operating threshold. I'll monitor hit rate, evictions, and successful page requests.

segments.speaker: C

title: 消息队列积压

segments.text: Scenario 57. Databases, middleware, and batch processing.
segments.spoken: Scenario 57. Databases, middleware, and batch processing.
